name: Webflow
description: Monitor Webflow sites and publishing status for web presence compliance

config.setupInstructions:
Step 1 — Log in to webflow.com
Step 2 — Go to: Account Settings > Workspace Settings > Integrations > API Access
Step 3 — Click "Generate API token" and give it a name (e.g. "Comp AI")

Step 4 — CRITICAL: Select scopes
   In the scope selector, check the box: "Sites > Read"
   (By default NO scopes are selected. Without this checkbox, the integration will fail with "OAuthForbidden: missing sites:read".)
   
Step 5 — Click "Generate token" and copy the token (starts with "wf-")

Step 6 — Paste the token below

Common mistake: clicking Generate without scrolling down to check the Sites > Read box. If your integration fails with a 403 "missing sites:read" error, regenerate the token with that scope enabled.
